title: Deterministic Containment of Probabilistic Intelligence, Multi-Rail Evidence Anchoring, and Intelligent Route Selection: The Squirl OS Journey, Volume II
description: Volume II of the Squirl OS research thesis (v2.1, adds Section 2.5 — the payload doctrine (byte-level wrapping conventions across nine rails) and the receipts-counted proof-corpus figure (76 mainnet proof transactions). The v2.0 edition ( supersedes-and-extends v1.0, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23303240) and v2.0 (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23482711) remain live per the append-only doctrine. Documents the multi-rail evidence anchoring protocol family (DWR-1, TWR-1, RTWR-1, QWR-1/2, PWR-1, wallet crossfire, DeWR-1), the ten-route certification program with measured finality and cost per rail, the XTR-1 five-hop XRP custody speed record (35.45 s total, 7.09 s per validated hop), the IR-1 deterministic intelligent routing engine (live predictions within 0.6 s), the Cloudflare Workers + OpenRouter speed stack, and the patent layer (SQUIRL-IP-011, SQUIRL-OS-IP-012, IP ledger anchored at Bitcoin block 972026). Every claim scoped to its receipts; keyless byte-exact read-backs; all defects disclosed forward-only. This software is a prototype and is provided for educational and research purposes only. It is not intended for production use, commercial deployment, or safety-critical environments. All systems are experimental and may contain defects on them.
